clauses.clause: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control a Basri planeswalker, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
clauses.evidence: Trace: the trigger fires at your combat ([stimulus: this creature attacks alone], [... you_bear attacks]) and, with no Basri on the board, puts no counter; it does not fire on the opponent's combat. The condition-true case is not on the board. Packs: adherent_of_hope_your_turns_only.json (your Basri Ket; your combat, the opponent's combat, your next combat -> exactly 2 counters, 4/3) PASS; adherent_of_hope_opponents_basri.json (the opponent's Basri Ket -> no counter, 2/1) PASS. Tree = compiler template B2a-adherent-of-hope.
clauses.issue: 'Basri planeswalker' is read as NAME_CONTAINS 'Basri' + TYPE_EQ Planeswalker rather than the planeswalker subtype; equivalent for every printed card.
